claim: With AWS Directory Service you pay only for the type and size of the managed directory you use, with no up-front commitment and no minimum fee.
question: What do you pay for with AWS Directory Service?

values.display: pay only for the type and size
no up-front commitment and no minimum fee

evidence.quote: With AWS Directory Service, you pay only for the type and size of the managed directory that you use. There is no up-front commitment and no minimum fee.

claim: AWS Managed Microsoft AD is priced hourly per managed directory, and the bill lists each domain controller as a separate line item; additional domain controllers are billed on top of the managed directory rate.
question: How is AWS Managed Microsoft AD billed: per directory, per domain controller, or per user?

values.display: each domain controller as an individual line item

evidence.quote: Note that although the pricing table shown on this page lists the hourly cost per managed directory ($0.40 per hour), your AWS bill lists each domain controller as an individual line item.
In the future, you will be billed at the hourly rate per managed directory plus any additional domain controllers.

note: found while mining (pricing dimensions); the dollar values in the example are Region-specific and not in the claim

claim: Directory sharing has an hourly charge for each additional account the directory is shared with; there is no sharing charge for additional VPCs or for the account that owns the directory.
question: What does directory sharing of AWS Managed Microsoft AD charge for?

values.display: hourly sharing charge for each additional account
no sharing charge for additional VPCs

qualifiers.scope: AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory sharing pricing

evidence.quote: There is an hourly sharing charge for each additional account to which you share a directory. There is no sharing charge for additional VPCs to which you share a directory, or for the account in which you install the directory.

claim: Multi-Region replication of AWS Managed Microsoft AD Enterprise Edition is charged per GB of data transferred out of the domain controllers to the other Regions where the directory is deployed.
question: What is charged for multi-Region replication of AWS Managed Microsoft AD?

values.display: a charge per GB for the data transferred

qualifiers.scope: AWS Managed Microsoft AD multi-Region replication pricing

evidence.quote: There is a charge per GB for the data transferred “out” of your domain controllers to other AWS Regions where you deployed your directory.
